# WHITE and FRUIT contact observations

`white_fruit.tsv` records actual WHITE and FRUIT branches of the original private `touchEffects2` method.
Two source runs and the bundled JAR produced identical bytes.
All four compiled helper classes match across backends.
The fixture contains 409 cases, 821 snapshots, 2,463 actor views, and 412 actual calls.
Each actor view contains all 154 organism observation fields.

## Comparison contract

The fixed ledger and typed input inventory precede Rust replay.
Compare nongeometric state, velocities, effects, gases, statistics, endpoints, bounds, ARGB, reactions, reference identity, ordering, and RNG exactly.
Only `_m`, `_m1`, `_m2`, `_mass`, and `_I` retain the existing organism geometry allowance.
For finite geometry, use `1e-10 * max(1, abs(expected))`.
Check geometric NaN classification and signed infinity explicitly.
Energy, reproduction thresholds, and all other scalars receive no additional tolerance.

Only `_world` and `_visibleWorld` are named organism collaborator exclusions.
Setup selection remains separate callback-routing metadata.
Every other recorded observation remains a comparison obligation.
Full G/N blocks preserve every genome and gene value.
Whole-genome identity connects actor, infection, saved, and statistics references.
The separate genetics oracle covers per-Gene mutable-object alias topology.

## Execution and input authority

Compile `tools/reference/WhiteFruitOracle.java` against each pinned backend.
Run `biogenesis.WhiteFruitOracle NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` with the isolated arguments recorded in provenance.
The helper validates four explicit profile roots through `toRealPath` before accessing simulation state.
It rejects existing output directories and writes the new file with `CREATE_NEW`.
Six negative invocations cover each omitted root, an escaped profile symlink, and existing output preservation.
Positive processes have a 120-second bound; negative processes have a 30-second bound.
The existing runner cleans each owned process group.

Each case resets actual source defaults and records all 147 mutable primitive settings.
Initial organism attempts are zero; initial oxygen is `1000`.
Mutation bounds are `0..10000`; meta mutation is zero.
GREEN selection weight is seven; other selectable weights are zero.
The setup seed is `827364`.
No genesis or world frame executes.

Distinct supplied costs identify the infection and defensive payment paths.

| Setting | Ordinary supplied value |
| --- | ---: |
| WHITE energy consumption | 0.125 |
| VIRUS energy consumption | 0.25 |
| BLUE energy consumption | 0.375 |
| DODGE energy consumption | 0.625 |
| SKY energy consumption | 0.75 |
| MINT energy consumption | 1.25 |
| LAVENDER energy consumption | 2 |
| INDIGO energy consumption | 0.5 |

Labelled cases explicitly supply zero divisors, shield limits, or raw atmospheric oxygen.
All settings appear in `U` before construction.

The helper creates real `VisibleWorld(null)` and World instances.
It invokes actual gas-add, organism construction, paste, and `World.addOrganism` methods.
Peer, victim, and killer are added in that order, at `(1000,1000)`, `(3500,3500)`, and `(2000,2000)`.
Their initial IDs are `0`, `1`, and `2`.
Peer is selected before the first add, avoiding MainWindow callback branches without mocks.
Actual contacts always use distinct victim and killer objects.

Five original genotype identities are supplied before actor construction.
Ordinary `g0` contains two genes with the selected WHITE or FRUIT color.
`g1` and `g2` ordinarily contain one GREEN gene.
Lengths are `12`; theta is `index * 0.25`.
The first branch is zero; subsequent branches are `-1`.
Symmetry is one, mirror is zero, and constructor booleans are false.
Generation is `41`; clade is `root`; all four modifiers initially equal one.
`g3` and `g4` use actual `GeneticCode.clone` on `g0`.
Shared-primary cases paste killer with the original `g0` reference.
Recipe and actor-reference choices remain explicit `I/A` inputs.
No observed genotype or organism snapshot becomes a constructor input.

Setup controls supply victim and killer energy `1000`, active/alive flags, and cleared relevant classification, defense, and version fields.
Both temporary colors begin MAGENTA with zero frames.
Photosynthesis begins at `10`; supplied photo coefficients are `index + 0.25`.
Victim initially holds `g3` as infection and `g4` as saved code.
Ordinary actor inputs enable plant and infectious flags.
The actor spore version is one for FRUIT and zero for WHITE.
Ordinary killer inputs enable plant, clear infection, and retain saved code `g4`.
Labelled cases supply each subsequent difference before its actual call.

The killer phenotype uses the selected current color while retaining its genuinely constructed body.
All explicit arrays must match the actual segment count.
Pink and cream controls mutate original GeneticCode fields.
Raw `_m` controls target the original per-segment length array.
The antiviral case supplies all 36 reaction arrays and nondefault movement/update flags before invocation.
These controlled states test methods; they do not assert natural contact eligibility or player UI acceptance.

## Source dispatch and coverage

Each `K` labels `touchEffects2.WHITE` or `touchEffects2.FRUIT`.
Its peer argument is the single CSV field `killer,seg,oseg`.
Before invocation, the helper checks the selected actor segment against the exact labelled ARGB.
Reflection then invokes the original `touchEffects2(Organism,int,int)` method.
An unexpected actor color fails before the call.

Each branch has a complete 66-color sweep.
Each sweep includes 46 selectable colors, 18 internal colors, unknown ARGB, and translucent MAGENTA.
The source inventory uses Java tokens and peer-switch brace depth, independent of indentation.
WHITE has 26 peer-case groups; FRUIT has 12.
Additional cases target nested decisions without multiplying all colors by all flags.

| Family | Cases |
| --- | ---: |
| WHITE palette | 66 |
| FRUIT palette | 66 |
| Focused boundaries | 277 |
| Total | 409 |

WHITE cases cover host classification, pure-virus costs, INDIGO exceptions, SILVER experience, PLAGUE thresholds, and signed infection counters.
They cover old-timer dodge precedence, only-C4 and auburn differences, partial payments, JADE defense, and antiviral neutralization.
BLUE observations cover partial defense, enhanced retaliation, actor death, and raw segment lengths.
SKY and DEEPSKY observations cover frozen/healing eligibility, enhanced bypasses, consumer versions, shared infection, and shield transitions.
Rigid-shell cases cover enhanced, killer, antiviral, consumer, pure-auburn, and silver-fungus distinctions.
Other cases cover PINK modifiers, CREAM immunity, SPIKEPOINT, CORAL, FALLOW, and active/inactive BARK effects.

FRUIT cases cover actor spore gates, dormant host availability, nonplant GREEN hosts, dodge, antiviral damage, and JADE defense.
The antiviral body contains FRUIT, DARKFIRE, unknown, translucent MAGENTA, and GREEN segments.
Its nondefault reactions, movement flags, update marker, and cached geometry remain fully observed.
SPORE cases include version boundaries, strong-threshold negation, signed minimum, and consumer exceptions.
Other cases cover SILVER immunity, SKY partial shields, strong/weak infection, enhanced-blond precedence, reproduction timing, and PLAGUE threshold four.
INDIGO cases observe donation without infection, including an already-owned infection.
Donation cases include the literal `0.0000002` reserve, neighboring values, signed zero, negative energy, infinity, and raw NaN.

Both branches exercise exact and cloned infection identities, saved-reference cleanup, Lavender refills, shield wrapping, and failed payments.
WHITE clears both infection references when infection exists; FRUIT retains them in its Lavender branch.
Both retain saved-only references when their source branch does so.
Death cases cover the strict tolerance boundary, already-dead peers, raw NaNs, and live statistics genotype aliases.
Three ordered second calls check statistics alias mutation and repeat-infection stability.

Every sequence preserves its initial RNG suffix.
No gene value changes, new genotype, or new World member occurred.
Actual infection and death events update the observed statistics and population.

## Preservation and limits

The producer verified all 74 original file hashes, sizes, and modes.
It preserved all 32 earlier TSV files.
The first 408-case candidate remains preserved in `.workflow-local/white-fruit-oracle-vkgr5ms6`.
Before Rust replay, the final candidate added one dodge case and nondefault antiviral cache inputs.
Both candidates passed independent source/source/JAR execution.
Provenance records the supersession and both hashes.
A later ledger correction moved all 821 snapshot markers from comparisons to schema metadata.
The superseded ledger, README, and provenance remain preserved.
Helper and TSV bytes did not change.

This fixture supplies original Java observations for two method branches.
It does not establish Rust parity until strict replay passes.
Full contact scheduling, physical collision, complete frames, corridors, and UI behavior remain separate acceptance gates.
